title: Minecraft Sugar Cane Farm 1.21 - BEST DESIGN - 5800+ Per Hour!
description:
TheySix is here with a new Minecraft tutorial, In this Tutorial I Will Show you how to make a Simple Easy Mega Sugar Cane Farm Only with 4 Observers In Minecraft 1.21

📚This sugar cane farm is simple easy to build and so extremely fast this farm can produce + 360 ~ +5800 - Or Higher Sugar Canes Per Hour ! ( the farm rate depends on the number of layers you built )
📚Recommended ( Optional ) : If you want to use the maximum efficiency of this farm, place the observers For each section ( 8 observers in total for each side )
📚This farm will work on both platforms ( Java Edition & Bedrock Edition )
📚You can build this farm on the Minecraft servers!
📚 If you want to produce more than +5800 per hour, you have to make more layers, there is no limit.
